parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of TV.

parameter.name: key
parameter.label: Access Key
parameter.description: Key exchanged with TV after pairing.

parameter.name: macAddress
parameter.label: MAC Address
parameter.description: If MAC Address of TV is entered here, the binding will attempt to power on the device via Wake On Lan (WOL) when it receives command ON on channel power. Accepted value is six groups of two hexadecimal digits, separated by hyphens or colons, e.g '3c:cd:93:c2:20:e0'.

parameter.name: broadcastAddress
parameter.label: Broadcast Address
parameter.description: If openHAB doesn't run in the same network as your TV, enter the IP address to send the WOL packet to. Accepted value is four groups of up to 3 decimal digits, separated by dots, e.g '192.168.1.255'.

parameter.name: useTLS
parameter.label: Use TLS
parameter.description: Enable Transport Layer Security. This is required by latest firmware versions and should work with older versions as well. In case of compatibility issues it can be disabled.

parameter.name: standbyOnline
parameter.label: Standby Online
parameter.description: Keep the thing ONLINE while the TV is in standby but still reachable on the network. The power channel is set to OFF in this case. The thing only goes OFFLINE if the TV does not answer on the network at all.
